newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS GIVES PROUD DAD PERUZZI TIME OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS GIVES PROUD DAD PERUZZI TIME OFF.

text.p: New-born Alessia Peruzzi lay cradled in the safest pair of hands in Italian soccer on Tuesday after proud dad Angelo interrupted preparations for Wednesday's European Cup final to dash home from Munich to see her.

Juventus keeper Angelo Peruzzi made a 6-1/2 hour round trip with the club's blessing after the news that his wife Alessandra had given birth on Monday night ruined his hopes of a good night's sleep ahead of the clash against Germany's Borussia Dortmund.
"I woke up at 0630 and flew to Turin in a private plane to be with my wife and the little one," Peruzzi said. "Then I came back to Munich -- I got here at 1300."
Peruzzi, who is also goalkeeper for Italy, said he would catch up on lost sleep later but expected to be completely focused by the time Juventus stride out to defend their title.
"I'm absolutely bowled over. But I'm sure that when I get on the pitch tomorrow I'll forget everything," he said. "Of course, it would be marvellous to win the cup for little Alessia."
